test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: As of April 2022, who among the following musicians is NOT a recipient of the Bharat Ratna?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Zakir Hussain__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hussain is a well-known innovator, yet he believes that innovation and continuity need to coexist.**
 
• Hussain has **worked with** **artists as diverse as Van Morrison and the London String Quartet** in addition to some of the best Indian musicians over the years.
 
• He **received the Sangeer Natak Akademi award** from **India's premier cultural organisation in 1991**, and in **1996, **he **contributed** to the music for the opening ceremonies of the **Summer Olympics in Atlanta.**
 
• Ustad Zakir Hussain is an Indian **tabla player**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravi Shankar:**

 
 
• At the Fillmore East in New York City, Hussain performed for the first time in the United States alongside Ravi Shankar.
 
• His connection with guitarist John McLaughlin, whom he met in New York, and violinist L. Shankar, an Indian, led to the creation of the musical group Shakti.
 
• Ravi Shankar was a well-known composer, performer, and expert in Indian classical music.
 
• He was a key character in 20th-century culture, and his contributions made him the figurehead of a significant musical heritage.
 
• **​**In 1999, Ravi Shankar received the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor.
 
• Pt. Ravi Shankar was a famous **Sitar player**.
 
 
 
• **Bismillah Khan:**
 
 
• **​**The Indian musician Bismillah Khan, often known as "Ustad," was instrumental in introducing the shehnai, a reed instrument, to the classical realm of Indian music.
 
• He was the third classical musician to win the Bharat Ratna, the nation's highest civilian honour, and one of the greatest exponents of Indian classical music.
 
• India's highest civilian honour, the Bharat Ratna, was given to Khan in 2001, and after his passing in 2006, the nation held a national day of mourning.
 
 
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar:**
 
 
• The "Swar Kokila" or "Nightingale of Bollywood," Lata Mangeshkar, was born in Indore in 1929.
 
• Her grandfather, father, and mother were all somehow connected to the music business, therefore music was in her blood.
 
• India's highest civilian honour, the Bharat Ratna, was given to Lata Mangeshkar in 2001.**​**
 
 

c7:T
